## History

Rogerson was a Sunday-school teacher who taught a class attended by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During a lesson, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) felt completely out of place while sitting in Rogerson's class.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rogerson.md)

Rogerson serves as Anne's Sunday-school teacher. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends her class alone after decorating her hat with flowers, though she finds herself feeling out of place during the lesson.
